<ic>To reform the Bloodcloaks Wintermark Army, a Grimnir (Physick) laden army.<br><br>''Proposed by Hahnmark, seconded by Bregasland''</ic> 
{{CaptionedImage|file=HengistMotion.JPG|caption=Full text of the original motion|title=The motion was withdrawn before being discussed.|align=right|width=450}}
===Overview===
* Permits the [[Wintermark|Winterfolk]] to begin raising a new [[Army]].
* Withdrawn after passage of a motion to allow the [[Dawn|Dawnish]] to [[Raise Dawnish army II|raise an army]].

===Date===
* Spring 379YE

===Costs===
* The motion would have had all the [[Army#Costs|standard costs]] of raising a new army.

===Campaign Outcome===
* The Bloodcloaks were originally a Wintermark army, lost to the [[Thule]] during the reign of [[Empress Brannan]]. Known for their crimson cloaks, the army was composed of many [[Wintermark_military_concerns#Grimnir|grimnir]] and [[mystics]]; all save a few were slaughtered during a disastrous retreat from [[Otkodov]].
